test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An object of size 3.0 cm is placed in front of a concave mirror of focal length 18 cm, at a distance of 54 cm. The image formed is ________ and its height is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Real and Inverted; 1.5 cm**.

**Concept:**

 
• **Concave Mirror:** A concave mirror is a spherical mirror that curves inward like a spoon. It can form real and inverted images or virtual and erect images depending on the position of the object.
 
• **Mirror Formula:** The relationship between the object distance (u), the image distance (v), and the focal length (f) of a mirror is given by the mirror formula:
 
• (1)/(f) = (1)/(v) + (1)/(u) 
 
• **Magnification:** The magnification (m) of a mirror is the ratio of the height of the image (h') to the height of the object (h). It is also related to the object
